name: get_candidates
description: The candidate pool: up to 150 titles TMDB suggests for this taste profile, best first (pre-ranked by overlap with the profile). Anything watched, started, rated, dropped, hidden or turned down is already left out; library titles stay (in_library). Every filter has a value for no filter: any, [], 0, empty or either. Each item: media_type, tmdb_id, title, date, genres, lang, anime, runtime (minutes; a show's per episode), seasons, ended, vote (TMDB), why (its sources: rec:<loved title> and similar:<loved title> are TMDB's picks for a title they loved; kw their keywords; new, gems and lang discover; trending, upcoming, on_air), in_library, watchlist.

media_type.description: movie, tv, or any for both.

genres.description: Any of these genres, by name as the profile and candidates name them (Drama, Science Fiction, Animation); [] for any genre.

min_runtime.description: At least this many minutes (a movie's runtime, a show's episode runtime); 0 for no bound. A bound leaves out titles with no known runtime.

max_runtime.description: At most this many minutes, as min_runtime; 0 for no bound.

year_from.description: Released (or first aired) in this year or later; 0 for no bound.

year_to.description: Released (or first aired) in this year or earlier; 0 for no bound.

language.description: Original language, ISO 639-1 (en, ja, ko); empty for any.

anime.description: only: anime only; exclude: no anime; either: both.
